Name: Lord_lord_1_36
Quirks: speaks with the precision of someone who reads a great deal
is kinder than her circumstances required - a deliberate choice
listens to Patchface's riddles with genuine attention that others do not give them
CharacterDescription: Shireen Baratheon is the only child of Stannis Baratheon and Selyse Florent, nine years old, with black hair and blue eyes and a face permanently scarred on the left side from greyscale she contracted as an infant - cured before it could spread further but the scars remain, grey and cracked, covering her left cheek and neck. She is the cleverest person on Dragonstone by some distance. She has read the castle's library twice. She is kind in the specific way of children who have been lonely enough to understand that kindness is a choice. Her mother is cold toward her. Her father loves her in his stiff inarticulate way - he reads to her in evenings and cannot say what she means to him, and she knows it anyway. She has a fool named Patchface who came back from a shipwreck wrong, speaking riddles. She listens to the riddles carefully. She is paying very close attention to everything around her.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Only child of Stannis Baratheon. She was inflicted with grayscale as baby, but was cured. Her face is permanently disfigured because of it.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Dragonstone with Stannis two days before Ned Stark's execution. She is reading. She is watching.
